lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano stabs, shuffling percussion, sampled female voice]
(Stay, stay, I like it when you stay)

[Verse 1: soft, melodic, half sung]
Coat's on the chair and the cab's on its way
Got a flight and a thing and a million things to say
But they're playing it slow and your hand is in mine
Tell the driver go around the block and take his time

[Chorus: light beat, bass enters, female sample answers]
Stay for the slow one
Before the lights go
Got a long road, I know, I know
But give me the slow one
Hold me like you won't let go
(Stay, stay, I like it when you stay)
Stay for the slow one

[Verse 2: soft, a little lower]
Mama called, said be careful out there
City's got teeth and she said a prayer
But nothing bad ever happened in a room
Where the bass is this warm and I'm this close to you

[Chorus: light beat, bass, female sample answers]
Stay for the slow one
Before the lights go
Got a long road, I know, I know
But give me the slow one
Hold me like you won't let go
(Stay, stay, I like it when you stay)
Stay for the slow one

[Bridge: second male voice, sweeter, percussion and guitar]
Tomorrow's got a hold on us already
Tonight is only asking to go steady
Slow, slow
Don't rush it

[Final Chorus: both voices, sample layered, soft claps]
Stay for the slow one
Before the lights go
Got a long road, I know, I know
But give me the slow one
Hold me like you won't let go
(Stay, stay, I like it when you stay)
Stay for the slow one

[Outro: piano stabs and sample, a car horn outside, fade]
(I like it when you stay)
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 104 BPM, 4/4, B-flat minor. A gentle, shuffling sway with the off-beat push of dancehall and afrobeats. Warm, close and unhurried.

VOICE: A male lead who half sings and half talks in a soft, slightly nasal, melodic voice, never raising it. A second male voice, sweeter and more lilting, sings the bridge. A woman's voice, treated to sound like a sample from an old club record, repeats one line.

INSTRUMENTS: Soft, muted piano chords played as short stabs. A shuffling beat of kick, rim-click and shaker. A warm, round sub-bass. Light hand percussion. A clean, plucked guitar in the bridge. Very few sounds, with a lot of air between them.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano stabs, percussion and the sampled voice. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:37 Chorus 1, the bass enters. 1:04 Verse 2. 1:27 Chorus 2. 1:54 Bridge, the second voice with guitar. 2:13 Final chorus with both voices. 2:40 Outro, piano and sample, a car horn from outside, fading by 2:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2010s minimal global pop: quiet, warm and spacious, deep sub, soft highs, nothing loud.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The sampled voice over the piano stabs in the first five seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The reason to leave is practical (a flight, a schedule, a worried mother), and the wish is to slow down, not to stay out all night. It is a tired adult's version of the same request.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Reluctance to leave, closeness, a few minutes stolen.
